parsed.why: Uncodified sharia criminalises gender nonconformity directly with flogging, imprisonment, death; documented raids, arrests, closed-trial lashes, and a trans woman beaten to death in custody; airport arrest for social-media expression. Severe state targeting.

Dress offence targets public presentation; conduct statute unenforced 2018-22 but security forces harass, arrest, torture LGBTQI+ people; hostile ministerial rhetoric; most open LGBTI people fled. High risk, though no documented prosecutions.

No criminalisation; supportive police at Pride marches, sole LGBTI organisation operating freely. No gender recognition, no general protections, documented rape and assaults (undated), possible passport-mismatch charge. Elevated but mitigated by civil society.

No criminalisation; prosecutorial guidance protecting gender-identity victims. But 2024 cabinet direction targeting LGBTQIA+ advocacy, marriage amendment, conservative climate, no protections. Aversion-level risk with no enforcement shown.

Criminalisation enforced: 3-year active sentence, police extortion, forced anal examinations as court evidence, mob violence with police participation, president's statement sparking hate-speech spike. State as perpetrator with no relief.
